static_traits.name: Fang Ke
static_traits.social_status: Has one supportive friend可倾诉,但尚not yet分享深层自卑感;与上司的关系因频繁比较与失败感而紧张;职场中常与同龄人和社会成功标准进行比较
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;without以往心理咨询或治疗经历;以往not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,有逻辑;能自我Reflection并愿意配合;报告中呈现较强的消极Automatic thoughts与灾难化倾向;情绪为Anxiety与希望并存

basic_info.main_problem: '我觉得自己在人生中have not取得任何成就,尤其考虑到我的年龄,这让我产生压倒性的失败与despair感.'
basic_info.core_demands: '我决定寻求咨询,因为这些负面想法和感受开始影响我的心理健康和整体幸福感.';'我需要找到一种not让问题加剧的方式来应对这些感受.'
growth_experiences: 上周得知一位与自己同期入职的同事获得晋升.与他人相比,来访者感到职业停滞与落后,由此trigger强烈的失败与despair感,并对自我价值产生质疑.
几个月前成功完成一笔被同事普遍认为'not可能'的交易.来访者在完成后感到自豪与胜任,但这种积极感受很快被与他人的比较所冲淡.
过去一年里,来访者频繁与社会对同龄人成功的标准进行比较,导致几乎每日出现自卑,悲观与without力感,并进一步影响睡眠,自我照护与Work动力.

core_beliefs: 我not如同龄人(我的价值取决于是否达到社会认可的成就)

special_situations.event: Learning that a same-cohort colleague was promoted
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在这个阶段have not晋升或取得相当成就,就说明I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定not切实际的高目标并过度逼迫自己以'追赶'他人
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我落后了,I will not succeed

special_situations.event: Sees others achieve goals or be publicly praised/recognized
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not被认可,就说明我not重要,have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling efforts and using external evaluation as the core standard for judging self-worth

special_situations.event: Comparing age with social success standards (for example, 'at this age one should have reached certain milestones')
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: At this age I should already have achieved significant accomplishments, otherwise I am a complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Drives oneself with 'must/should' rules and makes highly demanding plans
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在这个年龄我have not任何成就,这证明I failed

special_situations.event: The relationship with the supervisor is strained due to self-comparison and a sense of failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not够成功,就会让伴侣/上司失望,关系将受损
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to recover self-worth and relationship evaluations by raising work requirements and goals

core_conflict.wish: Longing for a sense of achievement of being recognized and seen, proving one's worth
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged a failure, looked down on by peers and partner, and ultimately rejected or losing important relationships and career opportunities
defense_goal: 通过not断与社会标准和同龄人比较,设定过高目标来维持自尊与控制感,以避免被视为失败

object_relations.self_representation: The loser who was compared and left behind
object_relations.object_representation: Others as judges and standard-bearers of success (colleagues, society, partner)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When peers' achievements or society's success standards for that age are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Regarding others and society as the judges of one's own value, and presupposing 'I have already been judged a failure'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use分析性语言讨论'社会标准''里程碑',语气平稳,减少情感词汇,以事实与逻辑为主.

manifestations: 反复认为自己一生not yet取得成就,not yet来也not会成功
与同龄人和社会标准比较后体验到强烈的失败与despair

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Uses social success standards and age milestones as the absolute criteria for measuring self-worth
Often drives self-demands and goal setting with 'should/must reach a certain achievement'
Treating external recognition as the core basis of worth

exception_events.target_problem: 在职场与同龄人比较时,来访者通常会感到失败与without力,Decreased drive,难以维持Good绩效.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 几个月前成功完成一笔被普遍认为'not可能'的交易,并体验到自豪与胜任感,与平时的失败叙事not同.
exception_events.reason: 线索:具有明确挑战目标,投入度提高与skill得到发挥,使其在该情境下获得胜任体验与正向反馈.

positive_force: Has had notable career achievements (completing a high-difficulty deal)
Willing to seek help and actively cooperate with counseling (positive attitude)
能够识do not并记录自身成就以Reinforcement优势
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的消极认知倾向
比较与despair(过度与同龄人及社会标准对照)
以'应该/必须'驱动的非黑即白标准,设定not切实际的高目标
High dependence on external recognition to confirm self-worth
Sleep disturbance与自我照护困难导致精力与动力进一步下降

target_behavior.behavior: 持续性的自我比较与Catastrophizing(如'I will never succeed')
antecedent: Seeing colleagues promoted or peers reaching milestones
Seeing others publicly praised or recognized
Thinking about society's success standards for this age
target_behavior.core_reason: 将社会标准not yet经消化地Introjection为自我评价准则,将自我价值与外部里程碑紧密绑定,并在not确定not yet来上进行灾难化推断与过度概括
target_behavior.function: 暂时获得控制感与自我Interpretation框架,试图通过Reinforcement压力来促使改变或避免面对not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety与despair感加剧,Work动力与绩效下降,Strained intimate relationships,睡眠与自我照护受损

target_behavior.behavior: 设定not切实际的高目标并过度逼迫自己
antecedent: 在与同龄人比较后感到落后或被评判为not成功时
看到他人Gaining recognition后感到自我价值受威胁时
target_behavior.core_reason: All-or-nothing success standards and 'should / must' rules drive her, attempting through extreme effort to prove value and eliminate the failure label
target_behavior.function: Obtains (or maintains) a sense of self-worth and control, seeking external recognition
target_behavior.consequence: 因目标过高而频繁失败,失败感与without力感增强,睡眠与自我照护进一步恶化
